versions.notes: 5-band TPT SVF parametric EQ with Neve-style DC-biased tanh saturation, one-pole param smoothing, SSL-style horizontal UI, test patcher with bpatcher integration

versions.description: layout cleanup - reorganized columns and spacing
Replace scale objects with native dial ranges; add readout overlays
Fix dial attrs: use min for offset, add presentation mode to readouts
Replace send/receive init with direct loadbang connections
Add background panel and title to UI
Review fixes: true Butterworth 6/12/18/24 slopes w/ crossfade, unity-gain saturation + DC blocker, direct param wiring (no global send), loadmess init, pattr varnames, contrast
Dial resolution: float-output Freq dials, log-mapped Q dials (Q=1 at centre), 2-decimal Q readouts
Readouts: integer-Hz Freq readouts (no truncated decimals), exact default freqs, readouts centred on dials
